scopeDecision: Current 0–16 roadmap closed under the user-approved bounded local release scope. Provider expansion and other environments are follow-up work chosen during use.

platforms.environment: Node 24.20.0, npm 11.19.0, Linux under WSL2, Chromium

platforms.evidence: Compatible design and Ubuntu CI configuration; separate native execution not certified.

coverage: page focus and visible focus indicators
accessibility.limits: Bounded Chromium accessibility baseline; no claim of full WCAG conformance or certification of individual screen readers.

agentIntegration.coverage: Stdio subprocess, initialization, bounded tools, preview/apply and report parity. Host-specific configuration remains user-selected.

providers.coverage: File-first adapter framework, mapped/lossless CSV, documented OFX/Wise subsets, host extraction fallback and optional cached acquisition boundaries.
providers.followUp: Additional institutions, formats, pricing/disclosure feeds and production connections are selected during use; no untested provider is advertised.

finalCheck.qualification: Passing package, Node and Chromium stages on unchanged clean source; maintainer visual/artifact review remains required.
finalCheck.evidence: Generated release-results/summary.json and browser HTML report; retained outside the public package.
finalCheck.limits: Development checks on dirty source do not qualify a release. Existing platform and provider limits remain unchanged.
